title: Cloud Storage (GCS) Request Metrics and Cost

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay sample `google:gcp:pubsub:message` events with `protoPayload.serviceName="storage.googleapis.com"` into `index=gcp`. Confirm UC-4.3.11 returns >=1 row and the alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `google:gcp:pubsub:message` traffic without `protoPayload.serviceName="storage.googleapis.com"`. Confirm UC-4.3.11 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=gcp` sourcetype=`google:gcp:pubsub:message` collected via `Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform`; validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.

description: UC-4.3.11 — Cloud Storage (GCS) Request Metrics and Cost: queries Google Cloud `google:gcp:pubsub:message` for search criteria `protoPayload.serviceName="storage.googleapis.com"` and returns actor, resource, and region context for security review and change validation.
value: On Google Cloud, cost anomalies and waste patterns for 'Cloud Storage (GCS) Request Metrics and Cost' erode FinOps guardrails and often reveal compromised accounts mining resources or forgotten idle infrastructure. UC-4.3.11 drives medium-priority security alerting before customer-impacting drift.
implementation: Enable GCS request logging to Cloud Logging; sink to Pub/Sub for Splunk. Collect storage metrics. Ingest billing export for cost by bucket. Alert on anomalous request volume or cost spike.
visualization: Line chart (requests, cost by bucket), Table (bucket, method, count), Bar chart (cost by bucket).
knownFalsePositives: Cloud billing and cost files often arrive a day or more late, include credits and refunds, and use tags that do not line up with app names, so a spike is not always a real overrun. We narrow alerts to sustained trends and we exclude test or sandbox projects when we can.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=gcp`.
• Install and configure `Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform` with the modular input for `google:gcp:pubsub:message`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.3.41.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `messageId` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Enable GCS request logging to Cloud Logging; sink to Pub/Sub for Splunk. Collect storage metrics. Ingest billing export for cost by bucket. Alert on anomalous request volume or cost spike.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:pubsub:message" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=gcp sourcetype="google:gcp:pubsub:message" protoPayload.serviceName="storage.googleapis.com"
| table _time messageId publishTime attributes
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.3.11_cloud_storage_gcs_reques_11"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `google:gcp:pubsub:message` in `index=gcp` to detect cloud storage (gcs) request metrics and cost. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `messageId` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_3_11_alert` with severity aligned to `medium` criticality. Dashboard: Line chart (requests, cost by bucket), Table (bucket, method, count), Bar chart (cost by bucket)..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade `Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform` and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of cloud storage (gcs) request metrics and cost so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
